1 Samuel 18:15 MSG
As Saul saw David becoming more successful, he himself grew more fearful. He could see the handwriting on the wall.

?
Anyone after your joy will watch helplessly even as God makes you extremely successful in all you do
?Your continuous success will make them afraid. They will behold you basking in success and be fearful.
?They will see the handwriting on the wall of your greatness and be in anguish in Jesus name✔
